content.expected_result: Normalization stops without choosing a content head or deleting either authored legacy definition.
preconditions: Prepare a legacy test package with distinct concurrent r2 and r2b children of r1. Preserve the fixture in Git.

steps.action: Run normalization, inspect both legacy definitions, then explicitly combine their content in Git and retry normalization.
steps.expected_result: The ambiguous attempt preserves all files; the explicit resolution produces one current definition, with previous values retained by Git.

content.title: Reject ambiguous legacy test definitions without losing content
